# BASELINE V1 — Frozen audit findings (2026-09-04). DO NOT EDIT.

## Extraction verification (44/44 records, ~460 fields)
Hard field errors: 15 (rate ~3.3%). MATERIAL ERRORS (4 + 1 borderline):
M1 oto-flinders-2025 — 6-mo primary between-group TFI stated "16 [6–25] p=.002"; best source: 9 [2–16] p=.006 d=0.62 (16/p=.002 likely 9-month/other estimate). ~78% overstatement of a commercial app's primary result.
M2 tdcs-meta-2022 — "prefrontal stimulation mainly helped comorbid depression/anxiety" vs paper: "no significant effect of treatment on psychiatric symptoms"; also scope: tDCS-only, 14 studies, N=1,031.
M3 acupuncture-sr-2020 — "18 RCTs" vs actual 8 RCTs/504; year 2021 (Acupunct Med); significant secondary THI −10.11 omitted.
M4 tavns-sr-2023 — "narrative synthesis only" false; meta-analysis of 4 studies with pooled positive disability effect of low clinical relevance (Fernández-Hernando et al., J Clin Med 2023).
M5 (borderline) physio-2022-somatic — actual: RCT N=40 of PT ADDED to photobiomodulation vs PBMT alone (Eladl et al., Medicine 2022); co-intervention hidden; "43% vs 12%" belongs to Tullberg 2006 (treatment record), not this study.
Endpoint audit: 1 violation (M1) + 6 borderline (levo TFI attribution; tyler NS full-cohort; shore co-primary-missed-in-ITT unstated; acupuncture secondaries omitted; uniti imported MCID; tent-a3 subgroup interim-defined labeling).
Loudness/distress flags (7): tactt TLQ instrument unnamed; acupuncture VAS construct ambiguous; tdcs instrument unstated + "LTA" naming; CI L:moderate vs mixed-VAS labeling; shore L:moderate w/ ITT p=.08; spi-1005 L:limited rests on PRO severity; hearing-aids L:limited basis thin.
Citation integrity: 32/44 fully correct = 73% (80% hard-only). Errors: phantom author "Cabrera A" (fuller-2020); wrong authors guillard-2023 (actual Jensen et al., Brain Commun, DOI 10.1093/braincomms/fcad185, N=94) and acupuncture-umbrella (actual Xu X, Xie H et al., Front Neurol 2022); kasper initials (actual CA/JM/NE); quiet1 year 2019 (DOI 10.1016/j.heares.2019.03.018, PMID 30939361, N=91); ~12 blank-but-knowable IDs (atipas DOI 10.5152/iao.2021.9385 PMID 34100746; levo PMID 29090311; bmj-nma DOI 10.1136/bmjopen-2024-096995 PMID 40441764; mazurek DOI 10.1007/s00106-025-01668-3; mckenna PMID 29131084; cochrane-betahistine 5 studies/~305; lllt Brain Sciences 11 RCTs/670; stopmd3 N=221; lenire-realworld N=212/220 authors McMahan & Lim; ci-meta authors Li/Yang/Niu/Sun); perrotta numbers unverifiable in accessible abstract (full-text PDF at tinnitusjournal.com).

## Blind re-rating (Agent C): 15 treatments, 60 comparisons, 11 disagreements, 4 meaningful
Meaningful: lenire score 3→2-or-demote; lenire replication limited→none; shore replication limited→none; rtms replication strong→limited/conflicting. Also required: act replication moderate→limited; recommended: shore safety strong→moderate; COI flags lenire/shore/digital-cbt. Full agreement on: cbt, hearing aids, CI, TRT, somatic physio, spi-1005, intratympanic, regenerative.

## Ranking stress (Agent D): 2 robust (digital-cbt, cbt-i) / 8 sensitive
Lenire −8 (COI weighting), −6 (quality); Shore −6 (COI), −5 (replication); rTMS +7 (quality/replication); CI +4 (loudness) −4 (quality); HA −4 (quality); MBCT +4 (durability); ACT +3; CBT #1 in 5/6 schemes (−3 only under pure loudness). Venous stenting outscores several Top-10 members on science dimensions; exclusion rationale undocumented.

## Regulatory: 13/13 confirmed (annotations: AirPods De Novo = DEN230081; Levo Gen 2 applicant = Levo Medical Corp). Sources: 43/44 records Level A (97.7%); 1 Level C (stopmd3, labeled); 0 D.

## Failure-mode ledger (baseline safeguard ratings)
Strong: THI/TFI-vs-loudness; regulatory terminology; registry status; AI identifier gates. Adequate: negative-RCT discovery; endpoint discipline (practice, not enforced gate); duplicate-vs-replication; preprint handling. Weak: COI weighting in rankings; score staleness. MISSING: retraction/correction back-check (grade D; a retracted foundational study would persist until manual audit).

## Baseline scorecard
Completeness C+ · Major-study recall B− · Weekly discovery C · Source quality A · Extraction B+ · Material interpretation B · Primary-endpoint B+ · Loudness-vs-distress A− · Negative-evidence B+ · Replication C · COI C+ · Safety B · Regulatory A · Citation integrity B− · Rating defensibility B · Ranking robustness C · AI evaluator B+ (provisional) · Retraction resilience D.
Verdict: MODERATE CONFIDENCE; launch NO until 8 blockers fixed.
